theater: 西奈半島、加薩走廊與戈蘭高地

battle.name: 第三次中東戰爭
battle.theater: 西奈半島、加薩走廊與戈蘭高地
battle.brief: 一九六七年六月五日至十日，以色列先以空襲奪取制空權，再以裝甲縱深突破，一百小時內攻佔西奈半島、加薩走廊、約旦河西岸與戈蘭高地。卡面的美製 M48 巴頓中型坦克是一九五二年生產的美國陸軍標準中型坦克，以軍曾以 M48A2 與 M48A3 成軍裝備，與百夫長協同負責追擊殲敵。

kit.name: 巴頓中型坦克
kit.history: M48是美國陸軍二戰後標準中型坦克體系的正式型號，擔任裝甲營主力，負責以主砲支援步兵、對抗裝甲目標並在機動作戰中推進占領。

countries: 第三次中東戰爭於一九六七年六月初爆發，以色列一方是統率全國的以色列國防軍：參謀長伊扎克·拉賓以中央指揮部統一調度北部、中央與南部三個戰區，國防部長本-齊翁·戈勒主持內閣決定，空軍參謀長莫德海·霍德掌握制空權，陸軍以裝甲軍、步兵師與傘兵旅為骨幹，並在數日內完成大規模預備役動員。阿拉伯一方是以埃及為核心的聯軍：埃及總統納賽爾以武裝部隊最高指揮官阿卜杜勒·哈基姆·阿麥爾元帥統率全軍，第二軍總部早在一九五六年蘇伊士危機後已由伊斯梅利亞前移到開羅，避免被一擊斬首；西奈戰線分為第二、第三、第四裝甲師，以及機械化步兵旅與步兵師，另有炮兵旅與工程部隊。敘利亞派出裝甲師與步兵師在戈蘭及約旦河東作戰；約旦由國王侯賽因率領國軍防守約旦河西岸與東耶路撒冷，伊拉克與沙烏地亦分別派兵赴埃及與敘利亞，敘利亞境內另有巴勒斯坦武裝武鬥人員參與。聯合國中東軍於五月被埃及下令撤出西奈，原本維持在那一線的均勢隨之崩解，六月五日之後阿拉伯各方的指揮系統陷入各自為戰，縱令仍在同一面旗幟下亦難以協同。埃及空軍與陸軍雖統一於阿麥爾元帥麾下，各裝甲師之間卻缺乏可靠通訊，命令多以電話逐級傳達；敘利亞與約旦的部隊同埃及之間從未訂立共同作戰計畫，聯軍只是一種名義上的聯盟。
countriesEn: The Third Middle East War broke out in the first days of June 1967. On one side stood the Israel Defense Forces, which under chief of staff Yitzhak Rabin ran the whole campaign from a central command, dividing the front into northern, central and southern sectors, with defense minister Shlomo Ben-Zion Gorer presiding over cabinet decisions and air force chief Mordechai Hod holding control of the skies; the army rested on armoured corps, infantry divisions and parachute brigades, and completed a large-scale call-up of reserves within a matter of days. On the other side stood the Arab coalition centred on Egypt: president Gamal Abdel Nasser exercised supreme command through field marshal Abdel Hakim Amer, and the Second Army headquarters had already been moved forward from Ismailia to Cairo after the 1956 Suez crisis so that it could not be decapitated in a single blow. The Sinai front was organised into the Second, Third and Fourth Armoured Divisions, together with mechanised brigades, infantry divisions, artillery brigades and engineer units. Syria committed armoured and infantry divisions to the Golan and to the east bank of the Jordan; Jordan's king Hussein led troops defending the West Bank and East Jerusalem, while Iraq and Saudi Arabia sent contingents to Egypt and Syria respectively, and Palestinian armed fighters also took part on the Syrian front. The United Nations Emergency Force was ordered out of Sinai by Egypt in May, and the equilibrium that had been held on that line collapsed with it; from 5 June onward the Arab command systems broke down into separate, uncoordinated theatres, so that even under a single banner they could no longer coordinate. Egyptian air and ground forces were nominally unified under Amer, yet the armoured divisions lacked reliable communications among themselves and orders travelled down the chain by telephone; Syria and Jordan never drew up a joint plan of operations with Egypt, and the coalition existed in name alone.
people: 關鍵人物集中在兩端。以方參謀長拉賓主張先發制人，空軍參謀長莫德海·霍德設計並指揮六月五日清晨的空襲，三小時內分三波掃過埃及十座機場；南部戰區指揮官阿里爾·沙龍主導西奈突破，第八裝甲旅在旅長亞伯拉罕·布倫納指揮下沿沙丘地帶深入沙姆沙伊赫方向；中央戰區由摩德海·古爾中將指揮，攻取耶路撒冷與約旦河西岸；北部戈蘭方向則由穆塔·古爾中將率領，第九、第十二裝甲旅由旅長阿米·阿雅隆率隊，於六月九日發動攻勢奪下戈蘭高地。沙龍其後出任國防部長並數度組閣，摩西·達揚在同年十一月入閣主持國防部，他與以西牆前的公開演說一同成為這場戰爭的象徵。阿拉伯方面，納賽爾雖握有最高決策權，卻在戰前數月屢下自相矛盾的部署：撤換空軍指揮官、把三個機械化旅調入西奈，行動本意是提高外交姿態，在以軍情報眼中卻成了進攻準備。阿麥爾元帥在首日下令總退卻，隨即被解除指揮；少將薩德·沙茲利在西奈第二軍前線主持撤退部署。約旦國王侯賽因同意與埃及敘利亞協同作戰，卻在停火階段仍以無線電與納賽爾確認聯盟立場，保留了國家的退路。以軍的作戰計畫由總參謀部作戰室在數日之內擬成，並非各戰區自行設計，這正是同一時刻三面出擊的前提；阿拉伯方面的決策卻停留在最高層的往返商議，前線指揮官收到的命令互相矛盾。
peopleEn: The decisive figures stood at the two ends of the conflict. On the Israeli side, chief of staff Rabin pressed for a preventive strike, and air force chief Mordechai Hod designed and directed the raid of 5 June, sweeping ten Egyptian airfields in three waves inside three hours. Southern Command under Ariel Sharon drove the Sinai offensive, the Eighth Armoured Brigade under its commander Abraham Brenner pushing deep across the dune country toward Sharm el-Sheikh. Central Command under Major General Mordechai Gur took Jerusalem and the West Bank, while the Golan was led by Major General Motta Gur, with the Ninth and Twelfth Armoured Brigades under the command of Ami Ayalon launching their attack on 9 June and carrying the heights. Sharon later became defense minister and formed governments more than once; Moshe Dayan entered the cabinet in November of the same year to run the defense ministry, and together with his public speech at the Western Wall he became the image of the war. On the Arab side, Nasser held the ultimate decision but issued mutually contradictory deployments in the months before the war: he replaced the air force commander and moved three mechanised brigades into Sinai, an act meant as diplomatic posturing, which Israeli intelligence read as preparation for attack. Field Marshal Amer ordered the general withdrawal on the first day and was shortly relieved of command; Major General Saad el-Shazly handled the withdrawal on the Second Army front in Sinai. King Hussein of Jordan agreed to a common front with Egypt and Syria, yet during the ceasefire he still confirmed the coalition's position by radio with Nasser, keeping the door open for his own state. The Israeli plan of campaign was drawn up in the general staff operations room within a few days rather than devised separately by each theatre, which is precisely what made a three-pronged attack possible; on the Arab side decisions remained in exchanges at the highest level, and the commanders in the field received contradictory orders.
kits: 卡面的 M48 巴頓中型坦克，是這場戰爭裡以軍裝甲序列中的二線主力。一九五二年美國陸軍定型的 M48 裝 90 公分砲，全重約五十噸，乘員四人（車長、砲手、裝填手、車機手），公路極速約每小時五十公里，火力與防護都屬中型坦克標準；以軍是 M48 系列在美國以外的主要用戶之一，先後接收六十輛 M48A2 與一百零五輛 M48A3，與英製百夫長三型、五型並肩作戰，但主力坦克仍由百夫長擔當——百夫長裝 105 公分砲，射程與穿甲都壓過 90 公分砲，M48 多配屬於預備裝甲旅與裝甲步兵營，負責追擊、警戒、對付反戰車砲與掩護步兵。除坦克外，以軍還有數十輛 M60A1、M24 自行反戰車砲、M41 輕坦與大量半履帶車，火炮為 105 與 155 公分榴彈砲，空中為幻影二 C、幻三與 A-4 攻擊機，海上則有以殼牌魚雷快艇為主力的巡邏隊。埃及方面的坦克主力是英製百夫長，另有 T-34/85、T-54/55、T-62、兩棲用的 PT-76 輕坦、AMX-13、中國製五九式，以及少量美製 M47 與 M48 巴頓；炮兵以自走砲與 152 公分大口徑榴彈砲為主，另有空降兵與空襲機群。敘利亞與約旦的裝甲以 T-54/55、T-62 及美製 M47、M48 為主。M48 全系產量約八千五百輛，在冷戰中期的中坦市場屬於暢銷型號，備件與訓練體系都容易取得，這也是以軍樂於採用它的原因之一。
kitsEn: The M48 Patton medium tank on the card was the second-line mainstay of the Israeli armoured order in this war. The M48, standardised by the US Army in 1952, carried a 90 mm gun, weighed roughly fifty tonnes, had a crew of four (commander, gunner, loader and driver), ran at about fifty kilometres an hour on roads, and its armament and protection sat squarely in the medium-tank bracket. Israel was one of the principal users of the M48 family outside the United States, taking sixty M48A2s and 105 M48A3s, and fought alongside British Centurion Mk 3 and Mk 5, although the Centurion remained the main battle tank: the Centurion's 105 mm gun out-ranged and out-penetrated the 90 mm, so the M48s were distributed mainly to reserve armoured brigades and armoured infantry battalions, where they handled pursuit, security, the destruction of anti-tank weapons and the screening of infantry. Beyond tanks, Israel fielded some dozens of M60A1s, M24 self-propelled anti-tank guns, M41 light tanks and large numbers of half-tracks, with 105 mm and 155 mm howitzers in the artillery arm, Mirage IIIC, Mirage 3 and A-4 aircraft in the air force, and a patrol force built around fast missile boats at sea. On the Egyptian side the Centurion was the principal tank, joined by T-34/85s, T-54/55s, T-62s, PT-76 light tanks for amphibious work, AMX-13s, Chinese Type 59s and a small number of American M47 and M48 Pattons; the artillery relied on self-propelled guns and 152 mm heavy howitzers, supported by paratroops and strike aircraft. Syria and Jordan fielded T-54/55s, T-62s and American M47 and M48 Pattons. Around eight and a half thousand M48s were built in all, and in the medium-tank market of the Cold War the type was a best seller, easy to keep in spares and easy to train on, which was one reason Israel took it gladly.
tactics: 以軍的戰法可以概括為「空襲奪制空、裝甲打縱深」。第一擊由一百八十三架戰機在三小時內分三波掃過埃及十座機場，把地面上的數百架阿拉伯戰機大半摧毀，制空權就此確立；緊接著地面部隊在航空火支援下同時在三個方向發動。西奈方面，突破點選在拉法與比爾吉夫加法之間的走廊，裝甲旅不與正面縱列營糾纏，而是循沙丘地帶長距離橫越，遠程打擊後方、油庫與指揮所；為維持縱深推進的燃料，以軍以加油機逐批向前轉場。第八裝甲旅向沙姆沙伊赫方向縱深奔馳，切斷埃及退路，比爾吉夫加法一線的埃及精銳裝甲師於是被分割包圍，其第二、第四裝甲師相繼成建制投降。約旦河西岸與耶路撒冷由中央戰區自北方迂迴，傘兵在米特拉山口與拉哈米姆機場空降，控制交通要點；巴爾勒夫運河防線在主戰區被繞過，只在塞得港一線稍作抵抗。戈蘭方向延至六月九日才動手，第九與第十二裝甲旅由布泰哈突破後直指大馬士革。整場戰役是裝甲兵一次縱深穿插、殲滅戰與追擊戰的結合。縱深推進的難點在補給：西奈內陸缺水缺電，油料要靠加油機由本土逐批轉場，裝甲旅平均每日推進數十公里，灘頭與縱隊之間的距離越拉越長；也正因如此，埃及第二軍放棄巴爾勒夫防線全線西撤時，西奈正面實際上已無成建制的抵抗力量。
tacticsEn: The Israeli method can be summed up as: seize the air with a strike, then fight in depth with armour. The opening blow was delivered by 183 aircraft sweeping ten Egyptian airfields in three waves within three hours, destroying the greater part of several hundred Arab aircraft on the ground and thereby establishing air supremacy; ground forces then attacked in three directions at once under close air support. In Sinai the breach was made in the corridor between Rafah and Bir Gifgafa. The armoured brigades did not brawl with the enemy in the line: they made long crossings through the dune country and struck at the rear, the depots and the command posts, and to keep the advance moving forward, refuelling aircraft were shuttled forward in batches. The Eighth Armoured Brigade ran deep toward Sharm el-Sheikh to cut the Egyptian withdrawal, and the elite Egyptian armoured division facing Bir Gifgafa was thus split and surrounded, its Second and Fourth Armoured Divisions surrendering as formations. The West Bank and Jerusalem were taken by Central Command through a northern hook, with paratroopers dropped at the Mitla Pass and at Rahamim airfield to seize the road net; the Bar Lev line along the canal was bypassed along the main axis and offered only limited resistance in the Port Said sector. The Golan was not attacked until 9 June, when the Ninth and Twelfth Armoured Brigades broke through at Buteiha and drove towards Damascus. The whole campaign was a combination of deep penetration, annihilation and pursuit by armoured troops. The hard part of such a deep advance was logistics: the interior of Sinai had no water and no electricity, fuel had to be ferried forward batch by batch from the homeland by tanker aircraft, the armoured brigades advanced by tens of kilometres a day, and the distance between the beachhead and the lead formations grew steadily; and precisely for that reason, when the Egyptian Second Army abandoned the Bar Lev line and withdrew westwards along the whole front, there was in fact no organised force left to resist in front of Sinai.
data: 可核對的數字集中在時間、兵力與損失三方面。戰役自六月五日零六時至六月十日零七時，共一百小時。以軍出動一百八十三架飛機執行一百九十七架次，三波空襲在開羅時間零七時四十五分至十時之間完成，摧毀埃及地面飛機三百架以上，整場戰爭以軍共損失十九架。兵力方面，以軍動員約二十萬人；阿拉伯聯軍合計約五十萬至七十萬人，其中埃及一線約十萬人，敘利亞約兩萬人，約旦約兩萬五千人，另有伊拉克與沙烏地部隊。戰果方面，以軍控制約兩萬五千平方公里土地，其中西奈逾兩萬平方公里、約旦河西岸逾五千五百平方公里、加薩三百七十平方公里、戈蘭約一千二百平方公里。坦克損失各方統計出入頗大，阿拉伯聯軍被擊毀或繳獲者合計約一千五百至二千五百輛，以軍損失約一百至二百輛；空軍方面，阿拉伯各國損失逾四百五十架，數千名埃及官兵被俘。陣亡數字同樣有爭議，以軍約七百八十至八百八十人，阿拉伯聯軍由一萬至一萬五千人不等。開戰前埃及空軍作戰飛機約四百二十架，第一日即損失逾三百架，餘機或撤或封存於西奈各機場；停火分三步生效，埃及於六月八日、敘利亞與約旦於六月九日分別下令，戰爭最後在六月十日零七時全面停止；紅海航線上的埃及商船屢遭攔截與襲擊，蘇伊士運河在停火後仍因航道淤塞與布雷而封閉多年。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked cluster around time, strength and losses. The campaign ran from 06:00 on 5 June to 07:00 on 10 June, a hundred hours in all. Israel flew 183 aircraft on 197 sorties; the three waves of the raid were completed between 07:45 and 10:00 Cairo time, destroying more than 300 Egyptian aircraft on the ground, and Israel lost 19 aircraft over the whole war. On strength, Israel mobilised about 200,000 men, while the Arab coalition fielded between half a million and seven hundred thousand, of whom about 100,000 were on the Egyptian front, some 20,000 in Syria and some 25,000 in Jordan, with Iraqi and Saudi troops besides. On results, Israel took control of roughly 25,000 square kilometres of territory: more than 20,000 in Sinai, over 5,500 in the West Bank, 370 in the Gaza Strip and about 1,200 in the Golan. Tank losses vary widely between sources; the Arab coalition lost somewhere between 1,500 and 2,500 tanks destroyed or captured while Israel lost about 100 to 200, and in the air the Arab states lost more than 450 aircraft, with several thousand Egyptian soldiers taken prisoner. Casualty figures are equally contested: between 780 and 880 Israelis were killed, and the Arab total is given anywhere from 10,000 to 15,000. Egypt had roughly 420 combat aircraft at the start of the war and lost more than 300 of them on the first day, the survivors being withdrawn or sealed in airfields across Sinai; the ceasefire came in three stages, with Egypt ordering it on 8 June, Syria and Jordan on 9 June, and the war finally stopping at 07:00 on 10 June. Egyptian merchant shipping on the Red Sea route was repeatedly intercepted and attacked, and the Suez Canal stayed closed for years after the ceasefire because of silted channels and mines.
cause: 這場戰爭的直接起因，是收局愈來愈緊的對峙。一九六五年解放巴勒斯坦組織在耶路撒冷成立，並在敘利亞取得基地；翌年以軍突襲約旦河東的卡拉梅營地，敘利亞支持的武裝隨即在戈蘭開火，以軍以空襲敘利亞陣地回應。一九六七年三月起，加薩地帶的炮擊逐日加劇，到五月已演成持續數月的邊界暴力，聯合國秘書長形容之為三個月的暴力。埃及於五月十四日撤走聯合國中東軍，五月二十二日海軍以水雷封鎖蒂蘭海峽，而美英兩國拒絕就自由通航作出保證，以軍參謀部遂判定生存受威脅；蘇聯與美國同時在東地中海集結艦隊，雙方都擔心戰爭會引來超級強權直接碰撞。五月十五日納賽爾撤換空軍指揮官並把三個機械化旅調入西奈，行動本身在外交上是升高姿態，在以軍情報眼中卻成了進攻準備；加上以方相信開羅無力單獨承擔後果，內閣遂在六月四日批准先發制人。英國此時只承諾不以為主動出擊，不肯為自由通航作擔保；法國把第十傘兵旅調往沙姆沙伊赫附近戒備，美國兩艘航空母駛入東地中海，雙方都在為最壞情況佈署，同時避免先動手而被指為挑釁。
causeEn: The direct cause of the war was a confrontation that kept tightening toward its conclusion. In 1965 the Palestine Liberation Organization was founded in Jerusalem and obtained bases in Syria; the following year an Israeli raid on the Karameh camp in the Jordan Valley was answered by fire from Syrian-supported fighters in the Golan, and Israel replied with air strikes on Syrian positions. From March 1967 artillery fire along the Gaza Strip escalated day by day, and by May it had become months of continuous border violence, which the United Nations Secretary-General described as three months of violence. Egypt withdrew the United Nations Emergency Force on 14 May, and on 22 May its navy closed the Straits of Tiran with mines, while the United States and Britain refused to guarantee free passage, so that the Israeli general staff judged its survival to be at stake; the Soviet Union and the United States simultaneously concentrated carrier forces in the eastern Mediterranean, each side fearing that the war would draw the superpowers into direct collision. On 15 May Nasser replaced the air force commander and moved three mechanised brigades into Sinai. The move was diplomatic posturing in intent, but to Israeli intelligence it read as preparation for attack. Combined with the Israeli assessment that Cairo could not carry the consequences alone, the cabinet approved a preventive strike on 4 June. Britain at this point undertook only not to open fire first and refused to guarantee free passage; France moved its Tenth Parachute Brigade to stand by near Sharm el-Sheikh, and two American carriers entered the eastern Mediterranean, all of them preparing for the worst while trying not to be the first to act and be branded the aggressor.
impact: 這場戰爭的後果遠超戰場本身。以色列在六日內取得西奈、加薩、約旦河西岸與戈蘭，控制面積增至戰前三倍以上，佔領問題自此成為國際議程核心，聯合國安理會於十一月通過二四二號決議，成為日後以土地換和平處理的基礎。阿拉伯聯軍在戰場上的崩潰，反而把政治重心推向巴勒斯坦武裝：解放組織的影響力上升，一九六九年其總部遷往黎巴嫩南部，其武裝在約旦境內遭清剿後另立黑色九月的名號。埃及因納賽爾辭職而震盪，隨後在蘇伊士運河東岸重拾消耗戰，以色列則把戰役經驗寫進新的國防理論，形成先發制人與縱深防禦的傳統，並在往後數年以縱深飛彈與電子戰系統對付阿拉伯反導體系。軍備上，以色列加速自製武器，軍工獲得空前市場；阿拉伯國家大量引進蘇聯與中國裝備，冷戰中東的軍備競賽自此升溫，而這一切最終在一九七三年重新開火時一次性攤牌。一九六八年以軍突襲安曼之後，阿拉伯方面的武裝報復迅速升級，一九六九年另有武裝組織以「黑色九個月」之名出現；一九七五年埃及與以色列簽署西奈協議、運河重開，一九七九年以軍自西奈撤出並與埃及訂立和平條約，佔領問題則由加薩與約旦河西岸一直拖到今天。
impactEn: The consequences of this war reached far beyond the battlefield. Within six days Israel had taken Sinai, Gaza, the West Bank and the Golan, and the territory it controlled grew to more than three times its pre-war size; the question of occupation became the core of the international agenda, and the United Nations Security Council passed Resolution 242 in November, which became the basis of every later land-for-peace settlement. The collapse of the Arab coalition on the field of battle pushed the political centre of gravity towards the Palestinian armed struggle: the influence of the PLO grew, its headquarters moved to southern Lebanon in 1969, and its fighters, after being hunted down inside Jordan, raised the separate banner of Black September. Egypt was rocked by Nasser's resignation and then resumed a war of attrition along the eastern bank of the Suez Canal, while Israel wrote the lessons of the campaign into a new defence doctrine, creating a tradition of the preventive strike and defence in depth and, in the years that followed, answering Arab anti-missile systems with long-range missiles and electronic warfare. In arms, Israel accelerated its own weapons industry, which found an unprecedented market, while the Arab states imported Soviet and Chinese equipment on a large scale; the arms race in the Cold War Middle East heated up from that point on, and it all came due at once when the shooting started again in 1973. After the Israeli raid on Amman in 1968, Arab armed reprisal escalated quickly, and in 1969 a further organisation appeared under the name of Black September; in 1975 Egypt and Israel signed the Sinai agreement and the canal reopened, in 1979 Israel withdrew from Sinai and concluded a peace treaty with Egypt, while the question of occupation, from Gaza and the West Bank, has been dragged out to this day.
result: 結果是阿拉伯方面的軍事與政治雙重失利。埃及失去西奈與加薩，蘇伊士運河的航線被封住而長期停航，納賽爾於六月九日辭職，一九六八年改選時仍以高分連任；第二軍與第四裝甲師成建制被包圍投降，第三裝甲師在比爾吉夫加法一線損失殆盡，數千官兵被俘。敘利亞失去戈蘭高地，約旦失去約旦河西岸與東耶路撒冷。以色列則以不到百人死亡的空襲換來整場戰爭的主導權，在停火線上留下面對阿拉伯國家整建軍的新態勢。但勝負並不等於解決：二四二號決議無法落實，被佔領地區的武裝衝突長期化，埃及的消耗戰與敘利亞的游擊戰把戰線拖入另一輪僵持，軍備競賽使雙方都獲得新武器，終在一九七三年重新開火。以色列在戰後大量接收美製新式坦克，車隊裡的 M48 巴頓陸續升級並延續服務至一九八〇年代，見證了從勝利的幻覺走向下一場戰爭的轉折。戈蘭的停火線把兩個戰區連成一條沒有縱深的前沿，以色列在同樣的地形上再戰一次時已改為縱深配備的「長城」體系；而一九七三年十月爆發的戰役中，以色列在戈蘭與西奈同時受攻，正面證明了一九六七年式的速戰速決並不保證下一次仍然得手。
resultEn: The result was a combined military and political defeat for the Arab side. Egypt lost Sinai and Gaza, the Suez Canal shipping line was closed and stayed closed for years, and Nasser resigned on 9 June, though he was re-elected with a large majority in 1968. The Second and Fourth Egyptian Armoured Divisions surrendered as formations, the Third Armoured Division was practically destroyed in the fighting around Bir Gifgafa, and several thousand Egyptian soldiers were taken prisoner. Syria lost the Golan Heights and Jordan lost the West Bank and East Jerusalem. Israel, for its part, bought control of the entire campaign with an air raid that cost it fewer than a hundred dead, and left the ceasefire line facing Arab states that were already rebuilding their armies. Victory, however, was not a solution: Resolution 242 could not be implemented, armed conflict in the occupied areas became a permanent condition, the Egyptian war of attrition and the Syrian campaign of raiding dragged the front into another long stalemate, and the arms race handed fresh weapons to both sides until the shooting started again in 1973. After the war Israel took delivery of large numbers of new American tanks, and the M48 Pattons in its columns were progressively upgraded and kept in service into the 1980s, bearing witness to the turn from the illusion of invincibility towards the next war. The ceasefire line in the Golan left the two theatres joined into a front with no depth at all, and when Israel fought over the same terrain again it had adopted a system of defence in depth, the Chinese Wall; and in the war that broke out in October 1973, when Israel was attacked at once in the Golan and in Sinai, it was proved beyond argument that the blitz of 1967 did not guarantee that the next war would be won the same way.
